prompt: Leave the voicemail your dad leaves after you already texted him that your flight landed.
response:
Hey kiddo, it's Dad. Just got your text—glad you made it safe. 

Listen, your mother is already rearranging the fridge for when you get here, so no rush but... don't take the scenic route either, alright? Traffic's gonna be a nightmare if you wait too long. 

Call me when you grab your bags. Love you. See you soon.
